purpose: Release-candidate treatment for the minimal structured online-memory loop. It preserves the complete V21 baseline context and CoT route behavior, learns from an initially empty store, performs deterministic action-time retrieval, and confines semantic repair, same-gate fusion, card-value audit, and lifecycle review to reflection checkpoints. Combat, card, and route responsibilities require explicit evidence-grounded production, review, or abstention. Every completed Act blocks before the next decision until a hash-bound external audit approves it.
